organisms.name: Staphylococcus aureus
organisms.prevention: Hand hygiene; wound care; contact precautions for MRSA
organisms.learnMore: S. aureus is one of the most common causes of skin infections worldwide. About 30% of the population are asymptomatic nasal carriers. MRSA (methicillin-resistant S. aureus) is a major hospital and community pathogen.

organisms.name: Ebola virus
organisms.morphology: Enveloped negative-sense ssRNA filovirus; characteristic filamentous or shepherd's crook shape

images.caption: Transmission electron micrograph of a filamentous filovirus particle

transmission: direct contact with blood or body fluids of infected person or animal
organisms.treatment: Supportive care; IV fluid resuscitation; mAb therapies (Inmazeb, Ebanga) for EVD-Zaire
organisms.prevention: rVSV-ZEBOV vaccine (Ervebo) for Zaire ebolavirus; strict contact and droplet precautions; PPE
